primary_answer: Current evidence is sufficient to avoid another integrated live regression, but not sufficient to close Phase 7. The remaining blocker is an offline contract defect: claims do not machine-distinguish direct facts from interpretations, material side-channel statements lack lineage, and field-aware numerical semantics are asymmetric across roles.

agent_status.bull: Live PASS on TESTCO with prompt v4, one call and no retry; accepted output is mostly supported but contains untyped interpretations and one weak adjective.
agent_status.bear: Live PASS in Phase 7.2D full-team run with prompt v3; conservative abstention and zero numeric mentions, but qualitative typing remains absent.
agent_status.risk: Live PASS in Phase 7.2D after one bounded incomplete-response retry; numbers are supported, but two absence/quality interpretations are weakly scoped.
agent_status.orchestrator: Deterministic dispatcher/aggregator with no model call or financial synthesis; offline integration coverage is sufficient.

integrated_live_regression.reason: Every specialist has live synthetic coverage on the same snapshot, the full-team path was exercised live for Bear/Risk, Bull uses the same shared execution machinery, and the aggregator is deterministic. Another paid run would not test or repair the remaining qualitative contract gap.

must_fix_before_phase7_close: Extend the existing claim object with machine-readable claim_type and support_type, or an equivalent nonduplicative contract.
Require evidence lineage for every material published statement, including factual limitations, uncertainty, and missing-evidence text; preserve only fixed generic abstentions as uncited.
Enforce evidence-family compatibility for direct facts and interpretations, including snapshot-scoped absence claims and both-side citations for comparisons.
Apply field/unit/category-aware numerical grounding symmetrically to Bull, Bear, and Risk.
Update all role prompts to explicitly distinguish FACT from INTERPRETATION and invalidate caches through prompt/schema identity.
acceptable_limitations: No universal Level-5 semantic-verifier model; deterministic Level 4 plus conservative framing is sufficient.
Argument confidence remains self-assessed support, not calibrated probability or forecast accuracy.
No model orchestrator exists in Phase 7; deterministic aggregation is safer and intentional.
Full run/attempt diagnostics remain in local ledger rather than all being displayed in the dashboard.
Browser disconnect cannot cancel an already-started provider call; timeout and budgets remain enforced.
next_action: Implement and offline-test one agent_output_v2 typed claim-support contract across Bull, Bear, and Risk, including cited material side-channel claims and symmetric numerical field matching; do not make a live call.
